title: Everyday questions
intro: Choose a situation, then tick the questions you want to ask. You do not need to write or share personal details.
housing1: What is the total cost, including utilities and any other charges?
housing2: What are the deposit, payment and refund conditions? Can I have them in writing?
housing3: Who can I contact about repairs or a problem, and how?
transport1: Does this service go to my destination, and where should I get off?
transport2: What is the total fare, and when is the last return service?
transport3: How can I confirm the route and pickup point before travelling?
phone1: What is the full cost, how much data is included, and when does it expire?
phone2: Does this renew automatically? How can I check the balance or stop renewal?
phone3: If documents or information are requested, why are they needed and who receives them?
food1: What is the total price and quantity before I agree to buy?
food2: Does this food contain an ingredient I need to avoid?
food3: Can I check the expiry date or return conditions before paying?
none: Tick at least one question to make your checklist.
privacy: Your choices stay in this open page until you reload or close it. Lift does not upload them. If you choose to share, the app you select handles that copy. Downloaded files and copied text can remain on your device.
limits: These are conversation prompts, not verified prices, service recommendations or legal, medical or financial advice. Confirm answers directly with the relevant provider.
language: The checklist uses the language you selected in Lift. You can use the external translation tools if you need another language.
exportTitle: My everyday questions — prepared in Lift
copyNote: No answers, personal details or provider information are included in this checklist.
copied: Your questions were copied. The text may remain in this device’s clipboard.
copyFailed: Copy did not work. You can download your questions instead.
shareHelp: Your selected questions and Lift’s explanatory notes are included. No plan or spending amounts are included. Choose the app and recipient in your phone’s sharing menu. Shared copies stay outside Lift.
shareUnavailable: Sharing is not available here. You can copy or download your questions instead.
shareReturned: The sharing menu has closed. This does not confirm that anyone received your questions.
